import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# --- Data from 4 seeds (read from server) ---
raw_data = {
    42: {
        'token_entropy': [3.2341948700181407, 1.9084596230213162, 1.4804942099201883, 1.3802752536019032, 1.3307051448147535, 1.306227946568574, 1.302270796821525, 1.2958505551009403, 1.3190636411000598, 1.2637236496440105, 1.275923746184411],
        'distinct_1': [0.0982156685333268, 0.09752517633628247, 0.081484375, 0.0758359375, 0.0731484375, 0.072203125, 0.071578125, 0.0707578125, 0.0707421875, 0.070578125, 0.0703828125],
    },
    43: {
        'token_entropy': [3.2341948700181407, 1.9091676850858001, 1.4656595424390364, 1.3254262710650406, 1.279669450498936, 1.269021630473583, 1.2518300341139152, 1.2554765175780178, 1.257325781006201, 1.2504059237245506, 1.2596111148477258],
        'distinct_1': [0.09833431219002871, 0.09963439966763606, 0.08178125, 0.076546875, 0.074, 0.072578125, 0.0720390625, 0.0712578125, 0.07090625, 0.070671875, 0.0703828125],
    },
    44: {
        'token_entropy': [3.2341948700181407, 1.8893646159023845, 1.5357174457488199, 1.34933725274223, 1.2902888727921988, 1.2215965429858964, 1.2218570889754503, 1.2368896414048354, 1.234068688945755, 1.2098825391972592, 1.2204927235832757],
        'distinct_1': [0.09808801064406446, 0.0976259850341037, 0.0813359375, 0.07571875, 0.07384375, 0.0734140625, 0.073203125, 0.0731640625, 0.073140625, 0.07309375, 0.0731015625],
    },
    45: {
        'token_entropy': [3.2341948700181407, 1.8999594054507678, 1.554124562829477, 1.4132002819281364, 1.3632528999895621, 1.330697440698161, 1.3042649574192924, 1.3292446320140179, 1.262256561301902, 1.3094564687306032, 1.315356376157965],
        'distinct_1': [0.09857404984654373, 0.09901316331405789, 0.0817578125, 0.075609375, 0.0732890625, 0.0725390625, 0.0720546875, 0.070828125, 0.0702734375, 0.0700390625, 0.069859375],
    },
}

gens = np.arange(11)

# Normalize each seed by gen 0, then compute mean/std across seeds
norm_entropy = []
norm_distinct = []
for seed in [42, 43, 44, 45]:
    te = np.array(raw_data[seed]['token_entropy'])
    d1 = np.array(raw_data[seed]['distinct_1'])
    norm_entropy.append(te / te[0])
    norm_distinct.append(d1 / d1[0])

norm_entropy = np.array(norm_entropy)  # (4, 11)
norm_distinct = np.array(norm_distinct)

mean_e = norm_entropy.mean(axis=0)
std_e = norm_entropy.std(axis=0)
mean_d = norm_distinct.mean(axis=0)
std_d = norm_distinct.std(axis=0)

# --- Okabe-Ito colors ---
COLOR_ENTROPY = '#0072B2'   # deep blue
COLOR_DISTINCT = '#D55E00'  # vermilion

# --- Figure ---
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 10,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.5,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'dejavuserif',
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.25, 2.5))

# Mean lines with shaded std
ax.plot(gens, mean_e, color=COLOR_ENTROPY, marker='o', markersize=3.5,
        label='Token Entropy (canary)', zorder=3)
ax.fill_between(gens, mean_e - std_e, mean_e + std_e,
                color=COLOR_ENTROPY, alpha=0.15, zorder=2)

ax.plot(gens, mean_d, color=COLOR_DISTINCT, marker='s', markersize=3.5,
        label='Distinct-1 (downstream)', zorder=3)
ax.fill_between(gens, mean_d - std_d, mean_d + std_d,
                color=COLOR_DISTINCT, alpha=0.15, zorder=2)

# Annotation: 1-gen lead
# At gen 1, entropy already dropped to ~0.59 while distinct_1 is still ~1.0
# At gen 2, distinct_1 starts dropping to ~0.83
# Draw a bracket / arrow between gen 1 and gen 2 highlighting the lead

# Vertical dashed line at gen 1 to mark entropy drop
ax.axvline(x=1, color=COLOR_ENTROPY, linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.5)

# Annotation arrow pointing to the gap at gen 1
mid_y = (mean_e[1] + mean_d[1]) / 2
ax.annotate(
    '1-gen lead',
    xy=(1, mean_e[1]),
    xytext=(2.8, 0.72),
    fontsize=8,
    color='#333333',
    arrowprops=dict(
        arrowstyle='->', color='#555555', lw=1.0,
        connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.2',
    ),
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white',
              edgecolor='#999999', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.9),
    zorder=5,
)

# Double-headed arrow showing the gap at gen 1
ax.annotate('', xy=(1.05, mean_e[1]), xytext=(1.05, mean_d[1]),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#555555', lw=0.8),
            zorder=4)

# Axes
ax.set_xlabel('Generation')
ax.set_ylabel('Normalized Value (gen 0 = 1.0)')
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 10.3)
ax.set_ylim(0.3, 1.1)
ax.set_xticks(gens)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, linewidth=0.5)

# Final drift annotations on right margin
drift_e = (mean_e[-1] - 1.0) * 100
drift_d = (mean_d[-1] - 1.0) * 100
ax.text(10.4, mean_e[-1], f'{drift_e:.0f}%', fontsize=7, color=COLOR_ENTROPY,
        va='center', ha='left')
ax.text(10.4, mean_d[-1], f'{drift_d:.0f}%', fontsize=7, color=COLOR_DISTINCT,
        va='center', ha='left')

plt.tight_layout()

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_4/projects/distrib_canary_collapse/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_metric_trajectory.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_metric_trajectory.png')
plt.close()

print(f'Saved PDF and PNG to {outdir}/')
print(f'token_entropy final normalized: {mean_e[-1]:.4f} (drift {drift_e:.1f}%)')
print(f'distinct_1 final normalized: {mean_d[-1]:.4f} (drift {drift_d:.1f}%)')
